note: Service category taxonomy. Office descriptions are per-category on purpose: the same office does a different job for a different audience, so CPDO reads as zoning-and-permits under Infrastructure and locational-clearance under Business. See docs/adr/0003-service-category-taxonomy.md.

categories.name: Agriculture & Veterinary
categories.tagline: Support for farmers, fisherfolk and animal owners

offices.description: Register in RSBSA, request agri-fishery technical assistance, and claim certified seeds and planting inputs.
Engineering advice on farm structures, machinery and irrigation, including a field visit to your site.
Animal treatment, farm and home visits, livestock breeding advice, and travel health certificates for pets.

categories.name: Business & Trade
categories.tagline: Starting, running and growing a business in Legazpi

offices.description: New business permits, renewals, added lines of business, and Mayor's clearances.
Locational clearance confirming your site is zoned for the business you intend to run.
Register a cooperative, arrange mandatory training, and get endorsements for permits and accreditation.
Stall applications and rentals at Legazpi Public Market.
Stall applications and rentals at Albay Public Market.
Selling to the city: bidder registration, PhilGEPS postings, quotations, and questions to the Bids and Awards Committee.

categories.name: Certificates & Records
categories.tagline: Civil registry documents and official city records

offices.description: Birth, marriage and death records, corrections, legitimation, and certified copies.
Getting a document signed by the Mayor, and booking a city venue for an event.

categories.name: Employment & Livelihood
categories.tagline: Finding work, and working for the city

offices.description: Job matching and referrals, the OFW help desk, SPES, JobStart, and DOLE livelihood programmes.
Applying for a city post, OJT and immersion placements, certificates of employment, and service records.

categories.name: Environment
categories.tagline: Natural resources, waste and environmental compliance

offices.description: Environmental clearances and compliance, tree cutting permits, waste concerns, and natural resource management.

categories.name: Health & Wellness
categories.tagline: Health facilities, programmes and public health services

offices.description: Rabies mass vaccination, dog and cat registration, and reporting stray animals.
Drug testing, prevention seminars, and the community-based drug intervention programme.

categories.name: Housing & Resettlement
categories.tagline: Relocation, socialized housing and homeowners' associations

offices.description: Relocation site applications, buying a city-owned lot through socialized housing, forming a homeowners' association, and assistance after eviction.

categories.name: Infrastructure
categories.tagline: Building permits, land use and public works

offices.description: Building, electrical, mechanical and demolition permits, occupancy certificates, road and excavation permits, and reporting broken streetlights or drainage.
Zoning and land use certification, locational clearance, land reclassification, and subdivision approval.
Social welfare assistance, case management, and support for families in crisis.
PWD identification cards, medicine booklets and purchase booklets.
Community-based drug intervention, prevention seminars, and barangay anti-drug council support.
Medical, burial and financial assistance requested through the Mayor's Office.

categories.name: Tax & Payments
categories.tagline: Assessments, tax payments and property records
categories.onlineNote: Not yet. Neither the Treasurer's nor the Assessor's citizen's charter describes an online route - every assessment, payment and clearance listed here is a counter transaction. The city's online services page lists "Taxes", but the link behind it is an explanatory video rather than a portal. Business permit transactions are the exception, and those are under Business & Trade.

offices.description: Paying business tax, real property tax, transfer tax and community tax, and getting statements of account and clearances.
Tax declarations, property transfers, reassessment, tax mapping, and certified copies of property records.
